provenance.construction: Two-block group-algebra CSS code over Aff(F_19) = C_19 semidirect C_18 with action r=2. Element index is (x exponent)*18+(y exponent). With left and right regular representations, H_X=[L(a)|R(b)] and H_Z=[R(b)^T|L(a)^T], using a=[48,208,142,284] and b=[182,323,76,217].
provenance.notes: Equivalence review: checked against the current board entries and their published construction data; not equivalent to an existing entry. Deep RIS re-verification used fresh runs at 100,000 trials (pair depth 32), 500,000 trials (pair depth 48), 1,000,000 trials (pair depth 64), and 2,000,000 trials (pair depth 80). The final X-side witness has weight 88 and the final Z-side witness has weight 81; both were independently checked for opposite-kernel membership and non-stabilizer status.
